Priya S: Quick follow-up from the metering design sync — we need to pick staging semantics for enrichment + a prov strategy that keeps canonical events small but replays deterministic.

Alex M: I'm leaning push-based enrichment (staging -> enricher -> canonical). Async scales better and lets us batch enrichments. Key is a strong idempotency key: request_id + event_seq.

Jonah: Agree on idempotency key. We should also include an ingest_watermark field so compactor/promoter can decide when to move records.

Felipe: Two provenance approaches: (A) inline provenance array (human-friendly but large), (B) prov-pointer (sha -> separate prov-store). Option B saves tokens but requires prov-store atomicity/retention.

Priya S: If we go prov-pointer we must define failure modes: prov-store miss => canonical write with "prov_missing" flag + alert. Replays then treat prov_missing as degradable audit.

Alex M: For watermarking propose adaptive per-tenant watermark: advance based on commit lag p90, with a global floor so small tenants don't stall. Implementation: per-tenant shard state with last_seq_by_shard and safe_promote_ts.

Jonah: Reuse existing credits-compactor job but add "promote" mode. Compactor already has compacting semantics; extend to move staging->canonical when watermark passes.

Felipe: Cost ask: Evan's team should model prov-store (S3+index) costs vs event bloat. If prov-pointer wins, prov-store must be append-only and immutable for a TTL.

Priya S: Action items: Alex prototype staging topic schema + idempotency rules; Jonah draft watermark computation pseudocode + edgecases; Felipe run prov-store cost comparison and failure-mode matrix. I'll own integration tests for replay determinism.

metering-bot: heads-up: compactor-promote feature branch built and running on staging (build: 4f9c2b).

Alex M: small pseudocode for enricher idempotency: 
```
if seen(request_id, event_seq): return cached_canonical
else: enriched = enrich(raw); write_canonical(request_id, event_seq, enriched, prov_pointer)
```

Jonah: I'll sketch watermark estimator: compute per-shard p90 lag over sliding window, advance when p90 < threshold for 3 consecutive windows; backoff multiplier when backlog grows.

Priya S: cool. We'll sync next Wed to review prototypes. If you want to pair on the prov-pointer sketch ping me. Closing thread for follow-ups.
